_frame: Q(d,t,z) of gbg_sidepad_v1.fs: d across the tip (+ outboard), t into the wing (- = front), z chair world mm. Tongue centre = c. Shown LOW (pad below); HIGH = z-mirror about c.

slot.t_back(d): 19.1 + 1.31*(d+4) - 9.9  (6 mm normal web to strap slit S1; S1 only at z 203-272)

tongue.note: inboard corner only ~10 deep, outboard ~31 (S1 limits)

common.carbon_rod: Ø6 in Ø6.5 teardrop bore along t at d 9.4, z c-10 (LOW), from the tongue rear face to t ~ -29

A_button_is_catch.button: 12 (t) x 18 (z) stadium on nose outer face d 23.6, centre t -2.5, z c; travel 5 inboard (-d), hard stop
A_button_is_catch.slider: L-shape, button -> bar inside the tongue -> tooth; spring OD 6 along d from d 2.5 (seat) to d 10, t -2.5
A_button_is_catch.tooth: d 17.4 -> 21.1 (3.5 engaged), t 10-15, z c+-7.5; 6 deg taper on its front (t) face
A_button_is_catch.wall_groove: blind, in the outer wall inner face: d 17.6-21.4 (2.2 skin left), t 9.8-15.2, z c_k +-7.8, one per position (5)

B_hook_and_drop_keystone.carrier_side_faces: groove t [6.25,12.75] x 3.3 deep full height; channels to rear face z c+-5.075 and c+-[14.075,19.15]; hook rows z c+-[5.075,14.075], hook face t 12.75
B_hook_and_drop_keystone.insert: push back raised +8 (lips run in the channels), drop 8 onto the filler below / band floor
B_hook_and_drop_keystone.keystone: cell above the carrier; hangs on its lip (channel z +-3.4 rear->t 6.25, roof on lip top); underside ridge 3 x 1.5 along t (t -12..4) into a 3.4 x 1.8 groove on carrier top AND bottom faces
B_hook_and_drop_keystone.keystone_latch: button 10 (t) x 12 (z) on nose outer face d 23.6, t -9..1, z cell centre; slider travel 4 (-d); bolt d 15-19.6 (2.0 engaged), t 15-19, z cell centre +4.6..8.1, 30 deg lead-in; wall pocket d 17.6-19.8, t 14.8-19.2, one per keystone cell (cells 2-6)

C_steel_plunger.plunger: bought Ø6.5 x 45 crib plunger (17.8 knob) or Ø6 dowel + spring + printed knob, in a printed boss Ø16 on the wing outer face: d 23.6 -> 33.6, t 14, z c_k; one per position (5 per side)
C_steel_plunger.pin: Ø6, into the tongue d 17.4 -> 9.4 at t 14, z c; tongue hole lined with brass tube Ø8/6 x 8; 6 deg x 3 mm taper on the tip into a matching countersink (zero play)
C_steel_plunger.knob: pull outboard 6 to release; knob face at d ~45 (x ~161)
